summary: Toyota Auto Finance Receivables LLC and sponsor Toyota Motor Credit Corporation filed an 8-K reporting an auto-loan ABS transaction: an October 9, 2026 Underwriting Agreement with SMBC Nikko, CIBC, Citi, MUFG and TD Securities for Toyota Auto Receivables 2026-D Owner Trust notes. Classes total $1.9bn: A-1 $439.75mm, A-2a $496.092mm, A-2b $163.158mm, A-3 $659mm, A-4 $94.5mm, B $47.5mm, closing on or about October 15, 2026. TMCC sells receivables to TAFR LLC under a Receivables Purchase Agreement, then to the Trust under a Sale and Servicing Agreement. This is a routine term ABS securitization, not a special situation; watch pricing, credit enhancement and spread.
